name: Kawaii Kingdom
source: You visit a famous amusement park called, “Kawaii Kingdom” with your college classmates. But there is a creepy urban legend going around on social medal. "People who visit the amusement park vanish." You thought it was just a rumor until your friends are killed by a mascot... Can you escape from the amusement park?
translation: 你和大学同学来到著名游乐园“可爱王国”。然而，社交媒体上流传着一个令人不寒而栗的都市传说，“去过这座游乐园的人会消失”。你原本以为那只是谣言，直到朋友们遭到吉祥物杀害……你能逃出这座游乐园吗？
